## Feedback

_We’d love to hear how the Chargebee CLI fits into your workflow._

_Tell us what you’re building, what you’re trying to do, what works well, what feels confusing, and what you would like to see improved or added._

_Your feedback can be as brief or detailed as you prefer._

_Please do not include API keys, credentials, customer data, or other sensitive information in public issues._

_You can also run `chargebee feedback "what happened"`._
